long_biography.plain_text:
Bill Laurie helped make a new basketball arena possible at the University of Missouri through a family gift made with his wife Nancy. Their contribution supplied a substantial part of the project's funding, alongside state bonds and other private donations. Laurie described the decision as one the family had discussed together.

Basketball had shaped his life long before that gift. He played point guard for Memphis State in the team that reached the 1973 national championship game, then worked as a coach. He and Nancy also supported a new training centre at their alma mater. The resulting Laurie-Walton Family Basketball Center brought practice courts, training rooms and academic support into the men's programme's home.

uncertainties.detail: Nancy's Forbes profile and Walmart inheritance are hers. Joint commercial property and family-bank control establish Bill's own economic relationship; no personal Walmart stake, direct inheritance or separate billionaire valuation is asserted. Marriage/family access and investment primacy remain reasoned classifications.

Hall of Fame lists July 1, 1952, while Wikipedia lists July 5. The source's blank birth day is retained. Versailles is associated with upbringing but a strong independent birthplace confirmation was not established; no birthplace proposal.

Providence Bank was acquired in 2021. Historical sports and bank posts do not prove a current operating role. Current property co-ownership plus sustained management history supports broad Investor at medium confidence; the current formal family-office role is not verified.

Instagram, LinkedIn and personal-website searches and Facebook, Twitter, YouTube and TikTok searches did not establish a qualifying personal account. Namesakes and scraped directories were excluded. Paige Sports' domain did not load, so no company link is proposed. Wikipedia already exists. Trip Advisor, Zillow, Vimeo and Flickr lack established person-relevant use.

Walton family explicitly excludes marriage-only affiliation; Walmart corporate leadership is not established for Bill. Both are omitted.
